# Moen SwivelControl Kitchen Faucet


May 20, 2026


**Share**


---


### **More Flexibility, Easier Cleaning and Hands-free Control in the Kitchen**


The new[SwivelControl™ Kitchen Faucet](https://www.moen.com/innovation/swivelcontrol-kitchen-faucets) from Moen is a pulldown faucet designed with a rotating spray head, so users can enjoy more flexibility, easier cleaning and hands-free control in the kitchen.


Exciting features of the faucet include:


- **100% sink coverage:** wands rotate 360 degrees, so users can position the spray precisely where they want
- **Hands-free control:** once it’s set, the wand stays in place
- **Automatic redocking:** once the faucet is turned off, the wand automatically returns to its default position


The new SwivelControl innovation is available in two models with four finish options.


### **Ronan™ Pulldown Kitchen Faucet**


Fluid curves and smooth, tapered handles merge seamlessly to form the[Ronan Pulldown Kitchen Faucet](https://shop.moen.com/products/87918?variant=53528965415222) . The faucet creates a clean, transitional look that blends harmoniously with a wide range of kitchen designs.


### **Skiles™ Pulldown Kitchen Faucet**


Contemporary yet classic, the[Skiles Pulldown Kitchen Faucet](https://shop.moen.com/products/87899?variant=52952490705206) artfully combines simple Scandinavian design elements with mid-century modern forms, resulting in a clean, yet striking, transitional design.


###


SwivelControl Retrofit Wands are also available, allowing homeowners to enhance their existing Moen pulldown faucet with precise water direction, secure docking and the hands-free convenience of SwivelControl.
